title: Tenant
description: The isolation unit. Every stored or cached tenant-scoped record carries tenant_id, and every read resolves it through tenants/model.yaml rather than trusting the caller.

tenant_id.description: Also the cache key prefix (t:{tenant_id}:), the blob path prefix (/tenants/{tenant_id}/), and the EF global query filter predicate.

region.description: Drives byok/policies/residency.yaml and the compliance zone in deploy/compliance-zones/.

jurisdiction.description: Two-letter code. Resolves to compliance/jurisdictions/<code>.yaml and the tawheed jurisdiction override.

scheme.description: Certification scheme, e.g. MS-1500. 'none' is valid and produces requires-governance, not a permissive default.

compliance_zone.description: Must be consistent with region. Inconsistency is a provisioning error, not a runtime fallback.

dedicated_infrastructure.description: Opt-in for residency-restricted, data-sovereignty, or sustained-scale tenants.

closed_at.description: Set when status reaches 'closed'. Data is retained per tawheed/audit/retention.yaml, not deleted with the tenant.

then.description: Suspension revokes BYOK credentials before anything else. A suspended tenant with a live provider key is a tenant whose spend continues while its access does not.
